name: Sbu Authenticator
one_thing: Shows your two-factor codes, on your iPhone only, and never locks them.

features.name: TOTP codes
features.description: Time-based 6-8 digit codes (RFC 6238) per account with a countdown ring; never locked, works offline.
features.reason: The paywalled core of the original: after the trial the codes are hidden until you pay.

features.name: otpauth parameters and HOTP
features.description: SHA1/SHA256/SHA512, 6-8 digits, custom period, counter-based HOTP (RFC 4226) from otpauth:// URIs.
features.reason: Real QR codes use them; without them some accounts generate wrong codes ("Does not provide code").

features.name: Add from camera QR
features.description: Scan the otpauth:// QR shown by the site; issuer and account filled in.
features.reason: Main setup flow of the original.

features.name: Manual secret entry
features.description: Issuer, account and Base32 secret typed in a Form, with advanced options.
features.reason: Listed in the original; needed when the QR does not scan.

features.name: Copy with one tap
features.description: Tap a row to copy the current code; clipboard entry is local-only and expires.
features.reason: The daily use of the app; review: "I can copy but no where to paste".

features.name: Code list with search
features.description: List .insetGrouped of accounts with search; codes in statSmall; no full stop on the list.

features.name: Edit, reorder, delete
features.description: Rename issuer/account, reorder, delete with destructive confirmation.
features.reason: "Full control over your 2FA accounts" in the listing.

features.name: App lock
features.description: Face ID / Touch ID / device passcode on open and after backgrounding; content hidden in the app switcher.

features.name: Transfer export as QR
features.description: Show the selected accounts as otpauth-migration QR codes after authentication, to move them to another phone.
features.reason: Export Codes screen of the original.

features.name: Encrypted file backup
features.description: Export all accounts to a password-encrypted file (CryptoKit AES-GCM, key from password) via fileExporter, and import it back; reminder when no recent backup.
features.reason: Reviews: "I opened the app I lost all my codes". Nothing leaves the device unless the user saves the file.

features.name: Import from other authenticators
features.description: Read otpauth-migration://offline?data= QR batches (hand-written protobuf decoder, no dependency) and plain otpauth:// lists.
features.reason: Users arrived looking for the Google or Microsoft app; let them bring their accounts from the real one. Metadata does not name third-party apps.

features.name: Add from image
features.description: PhotosPicker + Vision barcode detection on a screenshot, no photo-library permission.
features.reason: Review: "It won't recognize the QR codes"; the QR is often on the same phone.

features.name: Guided first code
features.description: Empty state explains in two sentences what a 2FA code is and offers Scan / From image / Type; after adding, a one-line hint: copy the code and paste it on the site.
features.reason: 18 reviews find setup impossible, 9 do not understand what the app is for.

features.name: Folders
features.reason: Seen in the original; useful only with many accounts.

features.name: iCloud Keychain sync
features.description: Opt-in toggle in Settings, off by default (ADR-0008): kSecAttrSynchronizable items.
features.reason: Codes lost with the phone; ADR-0008 allows it only as opt-in.

features.name: One-time code AutoFill
features.description: Credential provider extension offering codes above the keyboard (ASOneTimeCodeCredential).
features.reason: iOS 18+ only: behind #available, no fallback needed (copy stays).

screens.name: Codes
elements: rows: issuer, account, code in statSmall, countdown ring
settings button (SbuAppShell, no tab bar, ADR-0001)

screens.name: Code detail
screens.purpose: One account, its code as the screen figure.
elements: SbuStat code closed by SbuFullStop in accent-authenticator

screens.name: Add
elements: manual Form: issuer, account, secret, advanced (algorithm, digits, period, type)

flows.name: First code
steps: Hint: copy and paste on the site

flows.name: Switch from another authenticator
steps: In the other app, export as QR

flows.name: New phone
steps: Open Transfer or import the backup file

fields.name: sealedBox
fields.note: AES-GCM of the JSON account list

data_model.storage: Keychain kSecClassGenericPassword, kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly, one item per account (secret + JSON metadata). Opt-in iCloud Keychain (kSecAttrSynchronizable) only when the user turns it on (ADR-0008). Settings in UserDefaults. No server.

monetization.model: Free download, weekly auto-renewing subscription with 3-day trial; codes hidden without it; ads and tracking (ATT).
paywalled_features: viewing codes after the first period
monetization.notes: Privacy label declares identifiers and usage data used to track. Name and imagery suggest Google/Microsoft Authenticator. Previous research: research/6754900760/spec.json, research/apps/authenticator.md.

review_risks.risk: Six Sbu 1.0 apps were rejected together on 14/10 for duplicates and opportunistic variants; same "Sbu X" naming, identical promise block, shared SbuKit.
review_risks.mitigation: Submit alone, never in a batch; answer the nine Resolution Center questions in the review notes; add a "How it differs from the other Sbu apps" line; distinct engraving icon and screenshots.

review_risks.risk: Shared SbuKit and generated project can read as a template app.
review_risks.mitigation: Review notes state who wrote it, what is shared (design system only) and what is specific to this app.
Privacy policy in metadata and Settings; every permission asked only from the button that needs it, with an IT/EN string naming that button; label "Data Not Collected".

review_risks.risk: Authenticators are a crowded category full of near-identical apps; a free clone with no difference can be read as opportunistic.
review_risks.mitigation: Review notes list what is concrete and different: codes never locked, encrypted file backup, import from other authenticators, HOTP and otpauth parameters, no network at all.

review_risks.risk: The original is reported for impersonating Google/Microsoft Authenticator; any echo in name, keywords or screenshots is impersonation.
review_risks.mitigation: Name "Sbu Authenticator", engraved Sbu icon, no third-party app names in metadata (lesson of commit 909af97); import described as "from other authenticator apps".

review_risks.risk: iOS 18 Passwords app also shows verification codes.
review_risks.mitigation: No key icon or Passwords-like layout; Sbu design system; notes explain why a separate app (no iCloud by default, HOTP, file backup).

review_risks.risk: Sbu Scanner already reads QR codes; reviewer may ask why codes are not a Scanner feature.
review_risks.mitigation: Scanner decodes and forgets; Authenticator stores secrets in the Keychain behind app lock. State it in the review notes.
Declare standard encryption for authentication/data protection in App Store Connect (ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption reviewed before submit).
